title: 谁说中国AI只会跟随：应用落地速度领先，三大优势藏不住
speaker: Yang Ming-Miao

segments.en: When, you know, this period of we're going, 30 years from now,
segments.zh: 当，你知道，我们经历的这个时期，30年后，

segments.en: we'll look back at this period and go, okay, this was the transition between
segments.zh: 我们会回顾这一时期，说，这是传统经济与最终人工智能经济之间的过渡，

segments.en: the traditional economy and eventually the AI economy.
segments.zh: 从传统经济到最终的人工智能经济。

segments.en: You could argue that China is the leader in terms of AI adoption,
segments.zh: 你可以说中国在人工智能应用方面处于领先地位，

segments.en: in terms of how quickly it's being spread to many parts of the economy.
segments.zh: 在它迅速传播到经济许多领域方面。

segments.en: How do economic planners look at the changing inputs and outputs of an AI economy?
segments.zh: 经济规划者如何看待人工智能经济不断变化的投入和产出？

segments.en: In other words, what are the things we need to start thinking about that,
segments.zh: 换句话说，我们需要开始思考哪些事情，

segments.en: you know, most people can't even imagine at this point, looking at this economy?
segments.zh: 你知道，在这一点上，大多数人甚至无法想象，审视这个经济？

segments.en: I think China has maybe three unique advantages in this AI revolution.
segments.zh: 我认为中国在这场人工智能变革中可能拥有三个独特优势。

segments.en: Number one is that you say it's adoption and real world scenarios and very broad users.
segments.zh: 第一是你说的人工智能应用、真实世界场景和非常广泛的用户。
